recommendations.sentence: Change the Cart step, where 2 people of this run ran into trouble.
recommendations.evidence: Both were price-led shoppers; $8.95 shipping on a $129.00 order was read twice before they left. Reported for balance: the current checkout is the better version, not a perfect one.

recommendations.sentence: Make the Payment step easier to get past, where 9 people of this run ran into trouble.
recommendations.evidence: It holds 3.1 s of attention against 1.2 s on the button beneath it, and nobody used the code: it costs attention without earning anything.

recommendations.sentence: Make the Payment step easier to get past, where 3 people of this run ran into trouble.
recommendations.evidence: All three look for a confirmation on the next screen, then stop. They end with no order placed — a failure, not someone choosing to leave.

recommendations.sentence: Fix what stops people on the Review step, where 9 people of this run ran into trouble.
recommendations.evidence: On the review step, “Confirm purchase” sits about 180 px below the fold. Of the 9 people who got that far, 0 looked at it. On your current checkout the same button was seen by 9 of 9, after 2.3 s on average.

recommendations.sentence: Change the Review step, where 4 people of this run ran into trouble.
recommendations.evidence: The fee holds the eye for 610 ms the first time and is returned to 2.4 times — the most re-read thing in the test. The total changes from $129.00 to $147.95 between the two steps.
